mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which increases discount rates and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth and lowers S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point or greater increase in the federal funds rate over a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of tightening (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point or greater increase in the unemployment rate over a 3-month window signals rising recession risk, which increases discount rates and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 2% or greater decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month window signals a broad-based demand contraction, which reduces earnings growth and lowers S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline by >=2% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of dual contraction in consumption and housing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity and rising earnings, which increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions and rising corporate earnings, which increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).
